# What is Terraform Developer Portal?

@include "beta/tdp.mdx"

Terraform Developer Portal is an internal developer platform that lets platform teams define patterns and workflows for developers.

> **Hands-on:** Try the [Get Started with Terraform Developer Portal](/terraform/tutorials/developer-portal) collection to create a template and add-on definitions, then deploy a sample application and its supporting infrastructure.

## How does Terraform Developer Portal work?

Terraform Developer Portal uses HCP Terraform no-code modules to standardize infrastructure and application deployments. Platform engineers define templates and add-ons, and application developers use them to deploy applications and supporting infrastructure.

There are several key workflows for Terraform Developer Portal: 

- **Day 0: Create templates and add-on definitions:** Platform engineers create shared templates for applications and their infrastructure. A template can create a code repository from a standardized template that includes your organization's libraries and best practices.

  Add-ons package reusable infrastructure configurations that application developers can install on top of their applications, such as a database or a cache.

  Shared templates and add-on definitions can reflect requirements from security, compliance, and finance teams. Refer to [Create and manage templates](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/template-create) and [Create and manage add-on definitions](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/addon-create) for more information.

- **Day 1: Deploy applications and install add-ons:** Application developers use templates and add-ons to deploy applications and install supporting infrastructure. Refer to [Use a template to deploy and manage an application](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/template-use) and [Use an add-on to deploy supporting infrastructure](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/addon-use) for more information.

- **Day 2: Invoke actions:** Platform engineers can define Terraform actions in the no-code modules that back templates and add-ons. Application developers can invoke these actions to maintain infrastructure, such as invalidating a cache or restarting a virtual machine. Refer to the [action block reference](/terraform/language/block/action) and [Invoke actions](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/action-use) for more information.
